title: Integrating Tessl with Claude Code
description:
Ready to connect your AI coding agent to your project's specifications? This quick tutorial shows you how to integrate Tessl with Claude Code in just a few simple steps.

Learn the one command you need (tessl setup agent) to get Tessl's MCP server running with Claude.  This setup allows your AI agent to become spec-aware by connecting it to your project's Spec Registry, paving the way for true Spec-Driven Development.

Want to learn more and connect with other developers?
Join the AI Native Development community: https://tessl.co/4ghikjh
